ul.li: New article data: article dimensions for machine jobfile and job change type. Check: 12-12/ 12-24/ 24-12/ 24-24 pockets. (Anticipation for the top inspections position depending on previous reference: if you must, move PLUG/DIP devices + change sliding plates depending on installed options ATLAS/NCG/NCL/Bottom Checks/HCI/BTM.)

Tooling preparation: standard: screws, starwheels, outfeed guides, plug gauges, sliding plates. Jars, non-round: Dip head, spinner wheels and rings, brush guiding, outfeed brush, article presence device, other specific tools: example: flask kit. For Jars bigger than TO82: JAR Plug device installation required + Plug wedge modification on software.
Optional non round spinner to set on all motor by moving the belt position + software modification in case of neck spinning to remind.
If possible, prepare the outfeed guides and starwheel on their support beforehand.

Have samples available and some good bottles.
Recommendations:
On one good bottle, put a mark on the position of the thickness position of inspection. Aim: to avoid breaking the samples during the setup.
If possible, having a measured bottle for OVAL, thickness and NCG (ring dimensions) helps to set the inspections faster.

Toolbox, with some guides and all kinds of screws like revered step screw for spinners, spinner roller…in case of maintenance to perform quickly, and cleaning. A list of tools recommended by Tiama is available in a separate document.
